HarvestHollow_Text_Npc0.en: The scarecrow moved last night. I\nswear.
HarvestHollow_Text_Npc0.fr: L'épouvantail a bougé hier soir. Je\nle jure.

HarvestHollow_Text_Npc1.en: I hid in the corn. They never found\nme.
HarvestHollow_Text_Npc1.fr: Je me suis caché dans le maïs. Ils\nne m'ont jamais trouvé.

HarvestHollow_Text_ReturnAsk.en: Ready to go back to the dock?

HarvestHollow_Text_Stay.en: Take your time. The tide can wait.
HarvestHollow_Text_Stay.fr: Prends ton temps. La marée peut\nattendre.
